name: final_packet_checks
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
L=Path.cwd();H=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
p=json.loads(Path('original-provenance.json').read_text());res=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());ids=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids'];assert set(res)==set(map(str,ids))==set(p)
for i in ids:
 b=Path(f'originals/{i}.jsonl').read_bytes();assert H(b)==p[str(i)]['raw_sha256'] and b.endswith(b'\n');o=json.loads(b);t=p[str(i)]['tokens'][0];assert json.loads(t['raw'])==o['statement']==t['decoded'];assert H(t['raw'].encode())==t['sha256'];assert H(o['statement'].encode())==t['decoded_sha256']
assert H(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes())=='10dde8f305a8dbabaa9fd70069f7a081d89acec66122f20bdf33449c7a3693ce'
b=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];assert b['calls_used']==len(charges)==3 and b['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==9
prev='0'*64;events=[]
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 e=json.loads(raw);assert e['seq']==len(events) and e['previous']==prev;events.append(e);prev=H(raw)
assert sum(e['event']=='attempt' for e in events)==9;assert sum(e['event']=='success' for e in events)==9
receipts=[]
for f in sorted(L.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 o=json.loads(f.read_text());assert o['exit']==0 and o['killed'] is None;receipts.append({'path':f.name,'exit':o['exit'],'wall_s':o['wall_s'],'sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes':o['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':o['child_cpu_cumulative_s']})
report={'literal_bindings_checked':20,'reservation_sha256':H(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes()),'search_calls':3,'search_queries':9,'get_attempts':9,'get_successes':9,'guard_hashchain_final':prev,'completed_receipts_at_check':receipts,'limits':'Sampler misses transients. Native search CPU/RSS and separate writer peaks unavailable. Current/future final receipt remains in terminal manifest, not this earlier snapshot.','accepted':False,'qualified_survivors':0}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'PACKET-CHECKS.json'],input=json.dumps(report,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print('20 original bindings, reservation, search continuity, 9-hop hashchain and',len(receipts),'completed receipts checked; no mathematical/formal verification executed')
